bug_description.original: Use-of-uninitialized-value in _idn2_punycode_decode called from _tr46 and idn2_lookup_u8. Uninitialized value was created by a heap allocation in u32_to_u8.
bug_description.normalized: In punycode_decode, the statement `b += delim(input[b])` unconditionally reads input[0] without checking that input_length > 0. When _tr46 passes an empty punycode payload (ace_len == 0) from a label consisting of only the ACE prefix "xn--", this reads uninitialized heap memory allocated by u32_to_u8.

source.description: Converts the Unicode codepoints after the 'xn--' ACE prefix to a UTF-8 byte string via u32_to_u8. When the label is exactly 'xn--' with no payload, e - s - 4 == 0 so u32_to_u8 is called with length 0. It returns a heap-allocated buffer (ace) with ace_len == 0, containing no valid bytes.
source.value_from: UTF-32 label content after 'xn--' prefix, derived from attacker-controlled domain string

sink.description: The expression delim(input[b]) unconditionally reads input[0] to check whether the character at position b is the Punycode delimiter (hyphen-minus, 0x2D). When input_length == 0, input[0] is beyond the valid buffer, reading uninitialized heap memory. MSAN reports the tainted result at line 166 where b is used in control flow.

root_cause.description: Missing guard: the statement `b += delim(input[b])` executes unconditionally regardless of input_length. When input_length == 0, b == 0 from the preceding loop that never executed, and input[0] is out of bounds. The fix adds `if (input_length)` before this statement.

tainted_value_origin.description: Heap buffer allocated by u32_to_u8 for zero codepoints; ace_len is 0 and the buffer content is uninitialized.

parser_admitted.description: ACE label detection: the label must be at least 4 characters and start with 'xn--'. The input 'XN--' satisfies this after TR46 case-folding maps it to 'xn--'.

coarse_trace.summary: Converts attacker-supplied UTF-8 domain to UTF-32, applies TR46 mapping (case-folds 'XN--' to 'xn--'), NFC-normalizes, and splits into dot-delimited labels.
Detects ACE label prefix 'xn--', converts the empty payload after the prefix to UTF-8 via u32_to_u8 producing ace with ace_len == 0, then calls _idn2_punycode_decode.

With input_length == 0, the delimiter-scan loop does not execute (b stays 0), then `b += delim(input[b])` unconditionally reads input[0], accessing uninitialized heap memory. MSAN detects the tainted value at the subsequent control-flow use.

fine_trace.note: Parses the attacker-supplied UTF-8 domain string "XN--" into UTF-32 representation. Produces domain_u32 = {'X','N','-','-',0} with len=5.

Converts the punycode payload after 'xn--' to UTF-8. Since the label is exactly 'xn--' after case-folding, e - s - 4 == 0 and u32_to_u8 is called with 0 codepoints. Returns a heap-allocated buffer with ace_len == 0 and no initialized bytes.

depends_on.via: domain_u32 → TR46 mapping → NFC normalization → label split → s, e pointers → e - s - 4 == 0

fine_trace.note: Calls punycode_decode with ace_len == 0 and the heap-allocated ace buffer containing no valid bytes. No length check before the call.

fine_trace.code: for (b = j = 0;  j < input_length;  ++j)  if (delim(input[j])) b = j;
fine_trace.note: Scans input for the last delimiter position. With input_length == 0, the loop body never executes, leaving b == 0.

Unconditionally reads input[0] (via delim macro: (input[b]) == 0x2D) to advance b past a trailing delimiter. With input_length == 0, input[0] is beyond the buffer, reading uninitialized heap memory from the u32_to_u8 allocation. Missing guard: no check that input_length > 0.
Uses the tainted b value in j = b. MSAN detects use-of-uninitialized-value here at the control-flow comparison j < input_length, where j derives from the uninitialized read at step 5.

poc.trigger: 4-byte input "XN--" (0x58 0x4e 0x2d 0x2d): an uppercased ACE prefix with no punycode payload, passed as a domain name to idn2_to_ascii_8z.

format.name: raw binary blob
format.contract: Exactly the 4 bytes 0x58 0x4e 0x2d 0x2d (ASCII "XN--"). This is an ACE label prefix with no payload characters; after TR46 case-folding to "xn--", the empty payload triggers the zero-length punycode decode path.
